description: This file defines the NewsAppState class, managing application state for a news app, including fetching news categories, handling errors, and managing saved articles.

classes.name: NewsAppState
classes.description: Manages the state of the news application, including fetching news, handling errors, and managing saved articles.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the app state by loading saved news and fetching categories, with error handling and fallback to mock data.

methods.name: articlesFor
methods.description: Returns list of articles for a given category.

methods.name: topHeadlines
methods.description: Returns a list of top headline articles based on the general category.

methods.name: generalDownList
methods.description: Returns articles after the top headlines in the general category.

methods.name: refreshCategory
methods.description: Refreshes news articles for a specific category from the network, with error handling.

methods.name: _fetchCategory
methods.description: Fetches news for a category from the repository.

methods.name: _useMockForAllCategories
methods.description: Loads mock data for all categories.

methods.name: isSaved
methods.description: Checks if an article with a given headline is saved.

methods.name: saveArticle
methods.description: Saves or updates an article in the local database and refreshes saved list.

methods.name: deleteSavedByHeadline
methods.description: Deletes a saved article by headline and refreshes saved list.
